name: Open fonts kit
tagline: Nineteen free typefaces picked from the most-used families on Google Fonts, ten core faces and nine more: UI sans, condensed and heavy headlines, editorial serifs, a superfamily, monos and a handwriting face, self-hosted through Fontsource.
author: Rasmus Andersson, Vercel, IBM, Instrument, Undercase Type, Mathieu Triay, Florian Karsten, Ryoichi Tsunekawa, Production Type, JetBrains, Łukasz Dziedzic, Omnibus-Type, Christian Robertson, Wei Huang, Erik Kennedy, Impallari Type, Colophon Foundry, Hanken Design Co.
install: npm install @fontsource-variable/<family> (one package per face; see the table)
